sources.locator: Page 2 electrical characteristics table, exact BZT52C11 row (marking code WG) and thermal characteristics table; page 1 mechanical data (Case: SOD123, Polarity: Cathode Band) and ordering information table, (Type Number)-7-F row
sources.evidence_extract: Official Diodes Incorporated DS18004 Rev. 38-2 PDF served from the manufacturer domain diodes.com. Page 2 electrical characteristics table, exact BZT52C11 row (columns Type Number/Marking/VZ nom/min/max/IZT/ZZT/ZZK/IZK/IR/VR/TC/IZTC): marking WG, VZ 11 V nominal, 10.4 V min, 11.6 V max at IZT 5 mA; ZZT 20 ohm at 5 mA, ZZK 150 ohm at IZK 1.0 mA; IR 0.1 uA max at VR 8.0 V; temperature coefficient 5.4 to 9.0 mV/C at IZTC 5 mA. Page 2 thermal table: PD 500 mW at TL=+75 C (Note 7), 370 mW at TA=+25 C (Note 8), TJ/TSTG -65 to +150 C; VF 0.9 V at IF 10 mA. Page 1: Case SOD123, Polarity: Cathode Band, ordering (Type Number)-7-F = Commercial SOD123 3,000/Tape & Reel, so the exact orderable is BZT52C11-7-F.
